description: Open-web searching cannot reproduce the source universe or systematic LexisNexis workflow described by the original project; empty search results will not establish that no event occurred.
required_followup: Compare coverage with accessible local and international reporting, public records, and the verified original search protocol if available.

description: Discovery includes English, French, and Kinyarwanda terms; translation and search-engine coverage may remain incomplete.
required_followup: Review relevant reporting in the source language and document translation limits.

description: Official latest dataset bytes, universe, and additional Coding Procedure remain unverified at assignment time.
required_followup: Coordinator to complete official-baseline and compatibility review before export.

description: The U.S. Department of State page surfaced by the broad search returned a technical-difficulties response ending “Exception: forbidden.” Its excerpt concerns a report titled 2022 Country Reports and is not treated as evidence for January 2021.
required_followup: No retry or alternate copy of the same report; seek independent date-specific contemporary reporting only if this lead becomes relevant.

description: For the adjacent-month Gatsibo school protest/refusal lead, the article reports 16 arrests and 372 enrolled students but does not establish how many people assembled or refused classes.
required_followup: The February 2021 unit should seek a source that directly reports participants or a defensible qualitative crowd size; do not use arrests or enrollment as turnout.

description: The Gatsibo report describes a school-expulsion grievance and alleged discriminatory treatment, but does not clearly establish that protesters demanded action from Rwanda’s government or a state policy rather than school administrators.
required_followup: If the February unit evaluates the lead, establish the protesters’ stated target and demand from direct reporting.

description: The Gatsibo school activity is dated 6–8 February 2021, after this unit; the report does not describe any January continuation.
required_followup: Check only against the February unit as an out-of-month lead; do not assign it as a January continuation.

description: A December-boundary search surfaced a Wikipedia Gashora protest snippet; the opened UK Home Office note reproduces an ACLED Gashora demonstration dated 15 April 2020. A UNHCR January 2021 operational update reports 316 people at the centre but no demonstration in its accessed text. Whether the snippets identify the same episode is unresolved, and no source reports January activity.
required_followup: Do not treat the secondary snippets as a January continuation. The UNHCR report is not comprehensive protest monitoring; retain the continuity gap if the lead is reviewed again.

description: A search-only motorbike-taxi gathering excerpt says January 13 without a year. It appears in a report titled for 2022, and the official page returned a forbidden error.
required_followup: Do not assign a January 2021 date unless an accessible non-evasive source establishes the event year.

description: The search-only motorbike-taxi excerpt gives no participant count; “significant” does not establish at least 50.
required_followup: Seek direct contemporary reporting with a count or a clear qualitative estimate before considering eligibility.

description: The excerpt describes objection to metering requirements and related costs, but the underlying report body is unavailable and the domestic demand/target cannot be independently checked.
required_followup: Verify the stated demand and own-state target from a source that can be read without bypassing the access denial.

description: The snippet reports police engagement and that demonstrations dispersed, but does not establish a state dispersal attempt or other response dimensions; the official source body was blocked.
required_followup: Verify each state-response dimension independently from accessible event-specific evidence.
